tool.name: chainMergeSort
tool.description: combine sorted chain files into one sorted chain file
tool.command: : > input_list.txt && #for $chain in $in_chains: echo '$chain' >> input_list.txt && #end for chainMergeSort -inputList=input_list.txt -tempDir=./ > '$out' && ## chainMergeSort does not check its writes: the output must keep every chain and end with a newline chains_in=\$(cat #for $chain in $in_chains: '$chain' #end for | awk '$1 == "chain"' | wc -l) && chains_out=\$(awk '$1 == "chain"' '$out' | wc -l) && if [ "\$chains_out" -ne "\$chains_in" ] || [ -n "\$(tail -c 1 '$out')" ]; then echo 'The output is incomplete, for example because the disk is full' >&2 && exit 1; fi

param.name: in_chains
param.label: Chain files to merge
param.help: Each file must already be sorted by score, for example by chainSort or axtChain.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`chainMergeSort`_ combines several `chain`_ files into one file sorted by score. Each input file must already be sorted by score. The tool reads the files in one pass and does not load them into memory. Thus it can merge data that is too large for ``chainSort``.
In UCSC's pairwise alignment pipeline (``doBlastzChainNet.pl``), many separate jobs make chains, for example one job per chromosome pair. This tool combines their chains into the single ``all.chain`` file that ``chainPreNet`` and ``chainNet`` need.
**Input**
One or more chain files, each sorted by score. If an input is not sorted, the output is not sorted, and the tool does not show an error. The tool accepts empty files.
**Output**
One chain file sorted by score. The tool numbers the chain IDs again, from 1.
.. class:: warningmark
The new numbers are necessary. Separate ``axtChain`` jobs each number their chains from 1, so two chains can have the same ID. ``netChainSubset`` finds the chain for each net by its ID. Thus this wrapper does not offer the upstream option ``-saveId``, which keeps the old IDs.
For implementation details see chainMergeSort's `source code`_.
.. _chainMergeSort: http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/admin/exe/linux.x86_64/FOOTER.txt .. _chain: https://genome.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/help/chain.html .. _source code: https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/blob/master/src/hg/mouseStuff/chainMergeSort/chainMergeSort.c
